title: Eight-sided Great Pyramid and the Templar flag

tellings.quote:
The Templar flag is an eight-sided
pyramid turned into a 2D shape. So, if
you take the Templar flag and you create
into a threedimensional object, you get
the great pyramid of Giza.

plain: The researcher Jay Anderson says the flag of the Knights Templar, a medieval order of crusader knights, is an eight-sided pyramid drawn flat, and that if you build it out in three dimensions you get the Great Pyramid of Giza. He draws the idea from the online commentator known as Dark Journalist and the author Joseph P. Farrell. If true, it would suggest the Templars held some secret knowledge about the pyramid.
